name: Statics that work from the graveyard work from there and not from the battlefield
notes: Conor, 2026-11-22: build graveyard abilities. "As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Mountain, creatures you control have haste" (Anger) applied from the battlefield and never from the graveyard. Now: Anger and Brawn in your graveyard, you control a Mountain but no Forest: your creatures have haste, not trample; the opponent's do not. Wonder on the battlefield (you control an Island) gives nothing: it is not in your graveyard. Valor in the opponent's graveyard, they control a Plains: their Hill Giant has first strike.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Mountain
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"No matter how hard I try, I always seem to return to this wicked world of Limbo. But this time will be different. This time, Belasco's soul will be mine to sunder. Come, my friends, for we have a battle to win."
—Magik, Illyana Rasputin

scryfallData.name: Island
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Dream Dimension. A benevolent fountain of ideals, the source of humanity's collective inspiration, and the home of the muses themselves. Its wonder never ceases to amaze me."
—Doctor Strange

scryfallData.name: Wonder
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Flying
As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control an Island, creatures you control have flying.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Plains
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Asgard is my home, my kingdom, and my pride. Its splendor, like the gods, shall be everlasting."
—Thor

graveyard.name: Anger
graveyard.oracle_text:
Haste
As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Mountain, creatures you control have haste.
graveyard.flavor_text:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

graveyard.name: Brawn
graveyard.oracle_text:
Trample
As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Forest, creatures you control have trample.
graveyard.flavor_text:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

graveyard.name: Valor
graveyard.oracle_text:
First strike

graveyard.flavor_text:
